results.releaseNotes:
Shared recipes now import exactly as they were written.

FIXED: Steps no longer go missing
A step with no time or water of its own, the kind that just tells you what to do, used to disappear when you imported a recipe. Every step now comes through, in order, with whatever the sender wrote.

FIXED: Pours written as a range
A pour given as a window rather than a single moment now lands in the middle of that window instead of being skipped.

BETTER: More of the bag travels with the recipe
Imports now read the roaster who produced the coffee, the basket a shot was pulled in, and the language a bag's notes were written in.

One you may not have found yet: any recipe in BrewSmart can be shared as a link, and whoever opens it gets the whole thing, beans included.

Plus reliability improvements and fixes throughout. Still free. No ads, no subscriptions.
results.description:
BrewSmart is your complete coffee brewing companion. Calculate the ratio, get coached through every pour, log the cup, then dial in the next one — and share the winner as a link that opens right in a friend's BrewSmart. All in one fast, focused app. No ads. No subscriptions.

Adjust water, coffee, or ratio and the other two update instantly. Perfect for pour over (V60, Chemex, Kalita), AeroPress, French press, moka pot, drip, and espresso — whether you're dialing in a new single-origin or scaling up a batch.

THE BREWING LOOP

1. Calculate — Tap or swipe water, coffee, or ratio; the others recalculate instantly. No keyboard, no guessing. Precise to 0.1 g.
2. Brew — Turn any recipe into a guided, step-by-step pour with target weights, timing cues, and a live countdown to your next pour.
3. Log — Save every brew to your journal with a rating, notes, grind, and temperature. Edit any detail later.
4. Dial in — Tell BrewSmart how the cup tasted — too sour or bitter, weak or strong — and get a specific adjustment for your next brew.

FEATURES

Brew Calculator
Tap or swipe any value — water, coffee, or ratio — and the other two recalculate instantly, precise to 0.1 g.

Pour Guide
Turn any recipe into a step-by-step guided brew with target weights and timing cues. Start from the built-in pour schedule, or build your own pours with a bloom and custom targets. A live countdown ticks down to your next pour. Or keep it simple with the plain timer.

Share Recipes by Link
Send any recipe as a link — it unfurls with a preview in the chat, and whoever taps it can see the pour schedule, grind, and temperature, then save and brew it. Has a coffee attached? Its details come along, so they can make your exact cup. No BrewSmart? The link opens as a web page. Coffees share the same way — on their own or with their recipes. Prefer a picture? Any recipe or journal entry becomes a clean, themed card.

Coffee Library
Keep every coffee you brew: roaster, origin, process, varietals, roast level and roast date, plus your own tasting notes. Attach a coffee to recipes and logged brews, then look back at every cup you made with it.

Dial-In Assistant
Brewed something off? Mark the taste — sour, bitter, weak, or strong — and BrewSmart recommends exactly what to change next time: grind, dose, ratio, temperature, or time. Apply it with one tap.

Brew Journal
Log every cup with a rating, tasting notes, grind, water temperature — and the coffee you brewed with. Add brews by hand or straight from the timer, and edit any detail later.

Recipe Collection
Browse a hand-picked collection of recipes — classics like the 4:6 Method, hot and iced — right from the recipes screen, and save any of them into your app.

Apple Watch Brew Coach
Start a guided brew from your wrist and follow the pour coach with haptic cues for every pour — no need to touch your phone mid-brew. Real-time sync keeps your watch and iPhone together.

Home Screen Widgets
Jump straight to your ratio or timer from the Home Screen.

Lock Screen Live Activity
Keep your pour timer and next-pour countdown on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

Siri & Shortcuts
Ask Siri to calculate your ratio or start a brew timer hands-free.

Recipe Management
Save your favorite water, coffee, and ratio combinations — plus grind and temperature — as named recipes. Attach one of your coffees, load any saved setup with a single tap, and edit every detail. Rename or delete anytime.

Brew Timer
Count-up timer with start, pause, resume, and reset — right on the main screen.

Grams or Ounces, °C or °F
Switch weight between grams and ounces and temperature between °C and °F — across the app, widgets, and Apple Watch.

Clean & Focused
No ads. No subscriptions. Light and dark mode. Optimized for iPhone and Apple Watch.

—

Whether you're calibrating your V60, dialing in espresso, or just making a better cup every morning, BrewSmart takes you from ratio to perfect brew — and remembers what worked.
